mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 3.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% activates monetary easing expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates fall.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL rising) without rate hikes (FEDFUNDS stable) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as real rates fall.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS stable, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth falling below 50,000 jobs signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS < 50000, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
